title: Game test
description: The result of one run of the standard Playwright test against a game. Which game it ran against is stored beside the document, not in it.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document follows.

status.description: What the run found out about the game.

oneOf.description: The game works: every step ran and the game behaved as expected in all of them.
The game is failing: a step ran against the game and what it checked did not hold.

The test itself failed: it could not be completed for a reason that is not the behaviour of the game, such as the browser not starting or the page never loading, so the run says nothing about the game.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was tested and why the run got its status.

game_url.description: URL of the game, or of the page it was launched from.

duration_ms.description: Total duration of the test in milliseconds.

video_path.description: URL path the session recording is served at, such as '/data/...'. Absent if the browser never started.

trace_path.description: URL path the Playwright trace archive (trace.zip) is served at, such as '/data/...'. The trace replays the run action by action in the Playwright trace viewer, so it is worth keeping at least for the runs that do not end in 'working'.

steps.description: The timeline of the test: every step it is made of, in execution order, with the evidence captured during it.

error.description: Why the test could not be completed. Present only when the status is 'test_failed'.

step.description: One thing the test does or checks, its outcome and the evidence captured during it.

action.description: Playwright action the step performed, such as 'goto', 'click', 'press' or 'expect'.

description.description: What the step does or checks, in words a person who does not know the test can follow.

selector.description: Locator the action targeted, if any.

oneOf.description: The step ran and what it did or checked held.
The step ran and did not hold. It is the step the test stopped at.
The step never ran, because an earlier step failed.

screenshots.description: Screenshots taken during this step, in chronological order.

console_messages.description: Warnings and errors written to the browser console during this step.

failed_requests.description: Network requests that failed or returned an HTTP error status during this step.

screenshot.description: One image captured during a step.

path.description: URL path the image is served at, such as '/data/...'.

console_message.description: One message written to the browser console.

source_url.description: URL of the script or page that produced the message.

failed_request.description: One network request that did not succeed.

status_code.description: HTTP error status returned. Absent if no response was received.

error.description: An error raised during the test.

environment.description: Browser configuration the test ran with.

viewport.description: Size of the browser viewport in pixels.

user_agent.description: User agent string the browser sent.
